service: operate the persistent cheapest-sufficient inference broker over a mode-0600 host-local Unix socket
precondition: Cold Red Gate has accepted an exact portable LISS carrier, provider credentials remain in its protected environment file, and no public listener is granted.
postcondition: Contracted local enterprises can exchange LISS-specific ActivityStreams inference activities through %t/liss-inference/inference.sock and receive append-only provider settlements.
effects: bounded outbound supplier calls selected by LISS
